points.quote: Generic utilities and UI building blocks, with no knowledge of VS Code itself.
The dependency-injection infrastructure and the services shared by every layer.
The Monaco text editor, which also ships standalone.
The full IDE shell. It provides the layout (parts such as the sidebar, panel, and status bar), the services for editors, views, and extensions, and the built-in features under `contrib/`.
The desktop application entry points. It runs the Electron main process, the shared process, and the CLI.
`platform` → `base`; `editor` → `base`, `platform`; `workbench` → `base`, `platform`, `editor`; Lower layers must never import from higher ones.
It also contains the extension host and the extension API implementation (`api/`).
